target_customer: Aerospace, defense and energy contractors that handle ITAR or CUI data and want to use commercial AI models
problem: Controlled data cannot be sent to ordinary AI APIs, and building compliant infrastructure is slow and costly for small contractors.
business_model: Per seat subscription ($40 per employee per month for small ITAR teams) plus custom enterprise plans; tokens billed at provider cost
product_category: Compliant AI gateway for controlled data

founders.name: Eric Magliarditi
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he spent most of his career launching government satellites at SpaceX, and earlier built computer vision models at MIT.

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing requests through a US only encrypted boundary is standard cloud engineering, but compliance evidence and audits add real work.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance audits and customer trust create a barrier, yet hyperscalers and gateway vendors can offer similar products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found; by 2026 other vendors such as TrueFoundry advertise ITAR capable gateways.

market_need_then: Defense contractors were restricted from using commercial AI on ITAR and CUI data; the founder's launch material argues few contractors sit in all three GovClouds. No independent spend data was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Compliance focused, plain; tagline Your AI gateway for controlled data.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found; niche B2B name with no known mascot or community.

pivots.from: GitHub for government documents (document revision tracking)
pivots.to: API gateway for ITAR and CUI compliant AI
pivots.why: Not stated; sourced from the YC listing and launch post versus the current site.

outcome_analysis: Consus is active, lists several defense startup customers and announced a FedRAMP High equivalent assessment in October 2026. Funding is not public and a solo founder team is thin, so the evidence supports a promising niche rather than a proven outcome.
notes: No funding amount, round or investor was found. Competitor search returned only 2026 items, so the dated list is empty. The FedRAMP High equivalence claim is self reported.
